# OdivonGYM - AI & LLM Index

> OdivonGYM is a next-generation SaaS gym and athlete management platform engineered for fitness centers, martial arts clubs, crossfit boxes, and sports studios.

## Project Overview
- **Product Name**: OdivonGYM
- **Core Platform**: Cloud-native SaaS (Angular 20 Standalone Frontend + NestJS Microservices Backend + Firestore Realtime Database)
- **Primary Domain**: https://gym.odivon.com
- **API Base**: https://mainapi.odivon.com/api/v1
- **Target Audience**: Gym owners, fitness coaches, personal trainers, studio operators, and athletic club members.

## Key Capabilities & Modules
- **Access Control & Hardware Telemetry**: Real-time turnstile relay integration, QR-code entry pass, face-recognition biometric kiosk, edge-agent daemon for offline/LAN door access.
- **Member Management**: Comprehensive member profiles, biometric & body measurement logs, multi-tenant RBAC permissions.
- **Classes & PT Appointments**: Interactive calendar, personal trainer slot booking, capacity-managed group sessions.
- **Billing & Subscriptions**: Integrated iyzico payment gateway, automated invoice & e-archive (GİB e-Fatura) delivery, in-app digital member wallet.
- **Athlete Workout & Nutrition**: Tailored exercise routine assignment, set/rep tracking, water consumption telemetry.

## Core Navigation & Endpoints
- [Home / Dashboard](https://gym.odivon.com/dashboard): Central member & coach portal.
- [Login](https://gym.odivon.com/auth/login): Secure member & staff authentication.
- [Register](https://gym.odivon.com/auth/register): 14-day free trial instant club registration.
- [Terms of Service](https://gym.odivon.com/terms): Complete SaaS licensing and platform usage terms.
- [Privacy Policy & KVKK](https://gym.odivon.com/privacy): KVKK (Law No. 6698) and GDPR compliance notice.
